more.headline: Shirtless Florida Man risks it all, running during Hurricane Milton
more.summary: Canadian Running Magazine reported this one on October 10, 2024. Full story at the source.

more.headline: 'I made it through unscathed', says Florida Man who rode out Hurricane Milton on boat
more.summary: Joseph Malinowski refused to leave his boat - telling followers he hadn’t even spilled his coffee amid 120mph winds

more.headline: Florida Man straps his whole house to ground as Hurricane Milton barrels down
more.summary: A man in Orlando, Florida has gone viral after a photo of his house being strapped to the ground was shared by local news.

more.headline: ‘That’s America:’ Florida Man catches fish IN STREET day after Hurricane Milton
more.summary: Two men caught a large bass on a flooded Orlando road on Thursday as a man on a riding mower came cruising down the middle of the drenched street – a moment of much-needed levity after days of wondering what Hurricane Milton would bring…

more.headline: Florida Man ‘Lt. Dan’ survives Hurricane Milton in sailboat
more.summary: Joseph Malinowski earned the nickname from the “Forrest Gump” character for riding out a hurricane on the water.

more.headline: 'If you don't laugh, you'll cry': Florida Man struggles after restaurant gutted by Hurricane Ian
more.summary: Kyle Sherman's life changed forever when Hurricane Ian made landfall in Southwest Florida, but he vows to reopen the restaurant that was his livelihood before the storm destroyed it.

more.headline: Topless Florida Man jogs outside as Category 3 Hurricane Milton approaches
more.summary: A topless Florida Man jogged outside in Tampa despite the imminent Category 3 Hurricane Milton on Wednesday, 9 October.

more.headline: Officials Tried to Help Viral Florida Man 'Lt. Dan' Before Hurricane Milton, but He Chose to Stay in His Boat
more.summary: Authorities say they offered evacuation help to a Tampa, Fla., resident who recently went viral on TikTok for not leaving his sailboat ahead of Hurricane Milton — but he is staying put

more.headline: Florida Man who strapped his entire house down ahead of Hurricane Milton becomes internet sensation
more.summary: Tampa resident Mohammed Nijem recently went viral after local news outlet Spectrum Bay News 9 shared an image of the extreme preparations that he took ahead of Hurricane Milton to X.

story.headline: Who is Lieutenant Dan on TikTok? Florida Man on boat goes viral amid Hurricane Milton
story.summary: A man who goes by the name Lieutenant Dan on TikTok has gone viral after attempting to stay on his boat during Hurricane Milton.
